composition_subtypes.role: sorting rows by x and obstacles by y to process in order
two-pointer merging of reachable intervals across successive rows

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort rows and obstacles, then use amortized two-pointer interval merging to propagate reachable columns.
payload.rationale: Combines sorting for efficient row/obstacle ordering with amortized two-pointer interval merging to achieve O(m log m) time given large n and up to 1e5 volcanoes.
